name: Churn retention manager
tagline: Steps in on cancellations and failed payments before you lose the customer
description: Watches for the two moments a subscriber is about to disappear, someone clicking cancel and a card that did not go through, and intervenes while there is still something to be done. source.excerpt: Shared as a retention layer that catches subscribers on the way out and explains afterwards why they went.

body:
## What it does

Watches for the two moments a subscriber is about to disappear, someone clicking cancel and a card that did not go through, and intervenes while there is still something to be done. It puts a meaningful alternative in front of them rather than a token discount, then logs the reason behind each departure.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @ColinMcDermott shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
